title: Saw that picture
html_source:
JAN VERMEER
Style: Baroque
Lived: 1632 – 1675 (17th century)
Nationality: Netherlands
CHRIST IN THE HOUSE OF MARY AND MARTHA

anchor.prefix:
Or sitting all day typing. Eyefocus bad for stomach nerves. What perfume does your wife use. Now could you make out a thing like that? 

To keep it up. 

1939#60

 Martha, Mary. I
anchor.suffix:
somewhere I forget now old master or faked for money. He is sitting in their house, talking. Mysterious. Also the two sluts in the Coombe would listen. 

1986#64

To keep it up.
